descripcion: Faults seeded in jira-con-fallos.csv. Based on the clean B3 export. Generated by herramientas/generar-sinteticos-fallos.ts.

sembrados.que: A new team, Data, only has eight weeks on record. Not enough to know what is normal for it.
The export was cut off on 21 September: only a few new tasks remain from the last three weeks.
Mobile App uses a custom status, "Pre-production window". It is a wait, but it is not recognised by name and by its category it would count as in progress.
In Payments, one in three tasks moves from backlog to done in one go, without going through in progress.
Mobile App closed 14 and 12 tasks at once in the same minute, at the end of two sprints, to clean up the board.
Customer Portal logs tasks in the tool once they are already finished, a few hours before closing them.
Customer Portal says it works in sprints, but for three months it has not recorded them in the tool.
Risk leaves six out of ten stories without an estimate.
Risk changed its workflow and since May its closed tasks have no time in each status.
Since April the Team field is not mandatory and almost one in three new tasks is created without it.
